verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with an official CLI (Wrangler), so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The observability and AI Gateway metrics items cover the user's own app monitoring, not vendor telemetry, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
